stem: A particle moves in a circle of radius 2 m with a constant speed of 4 m/s. Calculate the magnitude of the centripetal acceleration. (A) 8 m/s² (B) 4 m/s² (C) 5 m/s² (D) 6 m/s²

stem: A car moves at constant speed on the road as shown in figure. The normal force by the road on the car is N A and N B when it is at the points A and B respectively. [Figure: wavy road; A is the top of a sharp crest, B the top of a broader, flatter crest, with a dip between them] (A) N A = N B (B) N A > N B (C) N A < N B (D) insufficient information to decide the relation of N A and N B

What is the minimum value of ‘x’ for which the ball can reach the point of projection after reaching C? (A) 2R (B) 5R (C) 3R (D) (5/2)R
